en: Black-and-white postcard view over a calm lake with reeds in the foreground and a couple of small rowboats at the shoreline. Across the water stands a tree-covered shoreline with a church tower rising above the trees and a few buildings nearby. The sky is cloudy. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom of the image, including the name of the place and the publisher.
